issues.description: The Developer method for attending a course is named inconsistently: the problem statement and the template expect an instance method attend(course:), but the solution defines participateIn(course:). This naming mismatch (attend vs. participateIn) will prevent code that calls attend(course:) (e.g. Client.main) from compiling and confuses students about which method to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution use the same method name as the problem/template by renaming participateIn(course:) to attend(course:) with the same signature and behavior (Course? parameter, optional binding, incrementing monthsOfSwiftExperience and printing the success message). Alternatively, update the template/problem and any callers (Client) to consistently use participateIn(course:), but keeping attend(course:) is recommended to match the instructions.
